summary_1line: At Draupadi’s swayamvara many kings gather, fail to string the massive bow, while Krishna recognizes the disguised Pandavas among the crowd.

image_candidates.scene_text: Hundreds of jeweled kings rise in a crowded amphitheatre, all gazing with desire at Draupadi standing beneath the contest bow.
A powerful king strains to string the enormous bow but is flung to the ground, his crown and garlands scattering across the arena floor.
Krishna quietly points out the disguised Pandavas to Balarama among the crowd while celestial beings watch from the sky above the arena.
